briefdescription.para: XMEM write flags.

detaileddescription.para: The following flags can be or'd together and passed as a bit mask to XMEMWFF3_write().
write flag.
If XMEM_WRITE is used in XMEMWFF3_write(), the write operation will be performed directly without any validation or erasing of the destination sectors. Operation is done using udma.

briefdescription.para: Erase write flag.

detaileddescription.para: If XMEM_WRITE_ERASE is set in the flags passed to XMEMWFF3_write(), the affected destination flash sectors will be erased prior to the start of the write operation.

briefdescription.para: Validate write flag.

detaileddescription.para: If XMEM_WRITE_PRE_VERIFY is set in the flags passed to XMEMWFF3_write(), the destination address range will be pre-tested to guarantee that the source data can be successfully written. If XMEM_WRITE_ERASE is also requested in the write flags, then the XMEM_WRITE_PRE_VERIFY modifier is ignored.

briefdescription.para: Validate write flag.

detaileddescription.para: If XMEM_WRITE_POST_VERIFY is set in the flags passed to XMEMWFF3_write(), the destination address range will be tested after the write is finished to verify that the write operation was completed successfully.

briefdescription.para: Write STIG write flag.

detaileddescription.para: If XMEM_WRITE_STIG is set in the flags passed to XMEMWFF3_write(), the write operation is done using STIG command.

detaileddescription.para: APIs return XMEM_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMS if one or more of the input parameters are invalid (e.g., invalid flag combinations, NULL pointers, or out-of-range values).

briefdescription.para: Erase size bytes of the region beginning at offset bytes from the base of the region referenced by the XMEM_Handle.

simplesect.para: Erasing internal flash on most devices can introduce significant interrupt latencies while the erase operation is in in progress. The user may want to surround certain real-time critical code sections with XMEMWFF3_lock() and XMEMWFF3_unlock() calls in order to prevent uncoordinated flash erase operations from negatively impacting performance.

parameterdescription.para: A handle returned from XMEMWFF3_open()
The byte offset into the XMEM region to start erasing from (must be erase sector aligned)
The number of bytes to erase (must be integer multiple of sector size)
Success.
If offset is not aligned on a sector boundary
If offset exceeds region size
If size or offset + size exceeds region size, or if size is not an integer multiple of the flash sector size.
If an internal error occurred erasing the flash.

briefdescription.para: Function to lock the XMEM driver.

detaileddescription.para: This function is provided in the event that the user needs to perform some flash related operation not provided by the XMEM driver API set or if the user simply needs to block flash operations for a period of time.
For example, the interrupt latency introduced by an uncoordinated flash write operation could interfere with some critical operation being performed by the application.
XMEMWFF3_lock() prevents any other thread from initiating read, write, or erase operations while the user is performing an operation which is incompatible with those functions.
When the application no longer needs to block flash operations by other threads, XMEMWFF3_unlock() must be called to allow XMEM write or erase APIs to complete.

parameterdescription.para: A handle returned from XMEMWFF3_open()
Timeout (in milliseconds) to wait, or #XMEM_LOCK_WAIT_FOREVER, #XMEM_LOCK_NO_WAIT
Success.
If timeout has expired.

briefdescription.para: Read data from the XMEM region associated with the XMEM_Handle.

parameterdescription.para: A handle returned from XMEMWFF3_open()

The byte offset into the XMEM region to start reading from. Note: When using STIG mode, the offset + word size must not cross page boundaries (256 bytes). Operations that would exceed the current page will return an error.
A buffer to copy the data to.

The size of the buffer (number of bytes to read). If XMEM_READ_STIG flash is on, and bufferSize is higher than 4 (one word), only the first 4 bytes will be read. If XMEM_READ_STIG flash is on, bufferSize is not allowed to be lower than 4 (one word).
Write flags (XMEM_READ_STIG)
Success.
If offset + size exceed the size of the region.
If XMEM_READ_STIG flash is on and bufferSize is lower than 4 (one word). If the internal read STIG operation is failed.
If flags is not contain allowed bits.

memberdef.name: XMEMWFF3_write

briefdescription.para: Write data to the XMEM region associated with the XMEM_Handle.

simplesect.para: Writing to internal flash on most devices can introduce significant interrupt latencies while the write operation is in in progress. The user may want to surround certain real-time critical code sections with XMEMWFF3_lock() and XMEMWFF3_unlock() calls in order to prevent uncoordinated flash write operations from negatively impacting performance.

parameterdescription.para: A handle returned from XMEMWFF3_open()

The byte offset into the XMEM region to start writing. Note: When using STIG mode, the offset + word size must not cross page boundaries (256 bytes). Operations that would exceed the current page will return an error.
A buffer containing data to write to the XMEM region.

The size of the buffer (number of bytes to write). If XMEM_WRITE_STIG flash is on, and bufferSize is higher than 4 (one word), only the first 4 bytes will be write. If XMEM_WRITE_STIG flash is on, bufferSize is not allowed to be lower than 4 (one word).
Write flags (XMEM_WRITE_ERASE, XMEM_WRITE_PRE_VERIFY, XMEM_WRITE_POST_VERIFY, XMEM_WRITE_STIG).
Success.
If the internal flash write operation failed, or if XMEM_WRITE_POST_VERIFY was requested and the destination flash range does not match the source buffer data.
If offset + size exceed the size of the region.
If XMEM_WRITE_PRE_VERIFY is requested and the destination flash address range cannot be change to the values desired.
If XMEM_WRITE_ERASE is requested and offset is not aligned on a sector boundary
If XMEM_WRITE_PRE_VERIFY or XMEM_WRITE_POST_VERIFY is requested but the verification buffer has not been configured.
If flags is not contain allowed bits.

simplesect.para: This call may lock a region to ensure atomic access to the region.
